rationale: Blind and edge-case lenses ran; no blocking defects survived triage, and the acceptance lens was skipped because no spec/story was supplied (no-spec mode, so confidence is low by design). 14 observations were dismissed (documented design choices, speculative, or tests/perf nits; the `sel` scope and the `_scope` AND-prefix were verified in source). 2 deferred: (1) a summary-based session whose skill exists only in session_dims.skills with no kind-2 rollup row still counts as a slash command, which the new storage guide documents as a limitation; (2) kind-2 vs kind-4 name matching is exact, and whether plugin-prefixed or case-differing names can diverge between agent.skill.dispatch skill_name and command_name could not be confirmed from the diff.
